end.summary:
Copied shapes on a grid by counting units along each side; this was shown on practice and a new-situation question.
Recognised that moved or turned shapes keep the same size and shape in some examples; this is still practised and needs checking next time.
Practised continuing tile patterns; the seventh position was not yet worked out.
Used the dots-versus-gaps idea and identified that three dots make two units. Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised copying shapes by counting gaps between dots, and Myra used this method accurately, including explaining why three dots make two units. They also practised recognising moved and turned shapes; some examples were correct, while the idea still needs checking in new examples. Tile patterns were practised, but the seventh position remained unclear; no mix-up was noted as corrected later. At home, draw a small grid shape and ask Myra to copy it, then move or turn it and explain what stays the same.
